attempts.certificate: M1必须部署在最靠前的服务器N1。N1和N3各恰好承载一个关键服务，因此M2部署在N3。M3与M4必须同服，且N1、N3已各承载一个服务，故二者均部署在N2。N2恰好承载两个服务，容量约束及其余条件均满足。

judges.reason: The canonical deployment satisfies every constraint: M1 is on the lexicographically first server N1; M2 is on N3, giving each non-N2 server exactly one key service; M3 and M4 are colocated on N2; N2 has exactly two services including non-key services; all capacity, nonempty-server, incompatibility, and conditional constraints hold. The requested outputs also match the deployment.
judges.depth_evidence: M1 must be assigned to N1 by the lexicographic constraint. Since N1 and N3 must each contain exactly one key service and the only key services are M1 and M2, M2 must be assigned to N3. The remaining colocated services M3 and M4 cannot fit on the already occupied capacity-1 servers, so both must be assigned to N2.
judges.explanation_evidence: The certificate explicitly derives M1 on N1, M2 on N3 from the key-service requirement, and M3/M4 on N2 from colocation and server occupancy. These deductions are checkable and the stated assignment satisfies all remaining constraints.
